title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a process used to convert categorical data into a numerical format that can be used in machine learning models. Each unique category value becomes a new column, and a binary value (0 or 1) is assigned to indicate the presence of that category in the data.

hintAnswer: It creates a new column for each unique genre and assigns binary values.

title: Effect of One-Hot Encoding on the Model
text: By using one-hot encoding, each genre is represented as a separate feature in the model. This allows the model to learn the impact of each genre on the number of streams independently.
